meta.purpose: What does a year of food actually look like from the estate? Month-by-month, meal-by-meal, region-specific.
meta.baseline: 1 person, Ranikhet/Almora, 5 acres, 1 cow, 3 sheep, 3 goats, 25 chickens, 2 bee hives

milk.amount: 3-5L average (6-7L when cow milking, 0 when dry)

ghee.amount: Made from surplus milk — lasts months

cheese.amount: Goat cheese from surplus goat milk

seasonal.spring: Fresh peas, radish, spinach, early herbs
seasonal.summer: Tomatoes, beans, cucumber, capsicum, brinjal, bottle gourd
seasonal.monsoon: Ridge gourd, bitter gourd, pumpkin, rajma, greens
seasonal.autumn: Cauliflower, cabbage, carrot, beetroot, turnip, harvest potatoes
seasonal.winter: Spinach, mustard greens, radish, stored root vegetables

monthlyCost.inr_note: Rice, wheat, oil, salt, spices, tea

whatYouBuy.note: Everything else you grow or produce yourself.

january.whatYouEat: Saag (mustard greens) + roti from stored madua/jhangora + eggs + ghee + goat cheese + pickles

february.planting: Start tomato, pepper seedlings indoors. Plant peas, beans outside.
february.whatYouEat: Same as January. Start getting early greens.

march.milk: Cow may have calved — fresh milk! 10-16L/day peak.
march.whatYouEat: Fresh milk returns! Peas + eggs + greens. Abundance starting.

april.whatYouEat: Full breakfast: milk tea + 2 eggs + fresh peas. Lunch: vegetables from garden.

may.whatYouEat: Abundance. Multiple vegetables daily. Fresh eggs. Honey from hives.

june.whatYouEat: Peak summer harvest. Tomato + egg curry. Fresh salads. Honey in tea.

july.monsoon: Heavy rain — protect crops from waterlogging. Harvest honey.
july.whatYouEat: Monsoon vegetables. Fresh milk. Eggs. Honey harvest.

vegetables: Full monsoon harvest. Plant autumn crops.
august.harvest: Honey harvest (peak). Start preserving for winter.

september.preservation: Start sun-drying tomatoes. Make pickles. Store root vegetables.
september.whatYouEat: Peak harvest. Preserve abundance for winter.

october.preservation: Major storage month. Root cellar filling. Dried goods stocked.
october.whatYouEat: Harvest feast. Root vegetables. Stored grains. Preserved food.

november.preservation: Dry herbs. Process turmeric. Store root crops in cellar.
november.whatYouEat: Stored food increasing. Fresh greens decreasing. Eggs steady.

december.milk: Cow going dry soon. Goat milk ~1L/day.
december.preservation: Rely on stored food. Ghee, pickles, dried goods, root cellar.
december.whatYouEat: Winter diet: Saag + roti + eggs + stored food + ghee. Simpler but nourishing.

fats.status: COVERED — ghee is primary fat source

vitamins.dailyIntake: Variable by season — summer abundance, winter limited
vitamins.status: COVERED in summer/autumn. Winter is the gap.

winterFoodGap.whatYouHave: Stored root vegetables, ghee, eggs (4-6/day), winter greens (spinach, mustard), stored grains, pickles, dried goods
winterFoodGap.whatYouLack: Fresh variety. Limited vegetable diversity. Mostly eating saag + roti + eggs.
winterFoodGap.solution: Cold frame / simple greenhouse (₹2K-5K) extends growing season. More root cellar storage. Accept simplicity — winter is for rest.
winterFoodGap.severity: Medium — not starving, just less varied

carbGap.issue: Rice and wheat are bought, not grown
carbGap.solution: Grow madua (finger millet) and jhangora (barnyard millet) — traditional Kumaon grains. Can be ground into flour for roti. Reduces rice/wheat purchase by 50%.
carbGap.note: Potatoes are the easiest carb to grow — high yield at altitude.

fruitGap.issue: Fruit trees take 3-5 years to produce
fruitGap.solution: Plant in year 1. Buy fruit locally until trees mature. Almora market has apples, pears, plums.
fruitGap.note: By year 3-5, you have your own fruit.

teaGap.issue: You'll want tea daily but may not grow it
teaGap.solution: Grow tulsi (holy basil) for herbal tea — grows year-round, free. Buy black tea locally (₹200-400/kg). Or grow your own if Kausani-style tea gardens work at your elevation.
teaGap.note: Tulsi tea is free and medicinal.

selfSufficiency.method: Calories and nutrients from estate production vs recommended daily intake

milk.note: When milking. 0 during dry period (2-3 months/yr)

vegetables_winter.note: Spinach, mustard, radish, stored root veg

totalDailyKcal.note: Summer: adequate. Winter: 700 kcal short — fill with bought rice/wheat.

totalDailyProtein.note: Both adequate. 60-80g needed for active adult.

annual_average.note: 75% of calories from estate, 90% of protein

tea.canGrow: Tulsi tea is free and medicinal

regionDifferences.ranikhet: Full diet possible. Turmeric, ginger, ashwagandha, all veg, grains, fruit trees.
regionDifferences.peora: Best diet diversity. Deepest soil = most crops. Orange orchards = fruit.
regionDifferences.kausani: Limited by shallow soil. Tea possible. Need to buy more vegetables.
regionDifferences.dhanaulti: Heavy buying needed. Only apples + root crops viable. Short season.
regionDifferences.kasol: Valley floor crops only. Rice/wheat possible. Turmeric blocked by monsoon.
